Coming to San Francisco from your home country can be tough, although you're smiling, positive and working so hard to better your life here in the USA.

But before you start working or going to school, you may need to do credential evaluation for your foreign educational background. If you ask around, your immigrant family and friends may have had done an education credential evaluation for various purposes like employment, immigration, school applications and so on.

Founded by an immigrant just like you, we at AET are here to help.

In 2024, if you are in the Bay Area and looking for credential evaluation services, this article include 3 education credential evaluation agencies for SF so that you could have an idea of what agencies are out there for you.

Further Information about Education Credential Evaluation

Education Credential Evaluation, or Foreign Credential Evaluation/Foreign Education Evaluation, is a service provided by professional evaluation agencies to evaluate educational backgrounds, grades, etc. obtained outside the US.

It mainly includes 2 types of evaluations:

  • Foreign Degree Evaluation (Diploma Evaluation/Document by Document)
    This report includes U.S. degree equivalency only. It's a basic evaluation that often satisfies requirements for employment and immigration.
  • Transcript Evaluation (Course by Course)
    This most complete report includes U.S. degree equivalency, credits, grades, and GPA. It's recommended for college admission, determining transfer credits or applying for an advanced degree, licensing, USCIS RFE, and more.

with the purpose of making your foreign degree equivalent to US degree or educational equivalency evaluation.

For more information, click “What is Foreign Credential Evaluation?”

Or contact us for a free estimate.
